title: Choose the new hero
question: Same copy, green, type and button in all three; only how the road is staged changes. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: The open road
options.lineage: editorial landscape plate, road running off the page
options.thesis: The road grows to the full height of the hero, runs north to south and off the top and bottom edges, so it frames the page instead of floating as a small drawing.
options.viewport: Text left; the road on the right fills the green from top to bottom. On phones it sweeps across the full width under the button.
options.risk: Quietest; the road is still a drawing, just a bigger and more confident one.

options.label: Map plate
options.lineage: engraved map plate in a private-club atlas
options.thesis: The road sits on a deeper green plate with a double brass hairline frame and a small THE ROUTE label, like an engraved map tipped into a book.
options.viewport: Text left; the framed plate on the right is as tall as the text block. On phones the plate sits under the button.
options.risk: Most formal; the frame adds one more element to the first screen.

options.label: Itinerary road
options.lineage: first-class itinerary set along the road
options.thesis: The road carries the trip: FROM New Jersey at the top stop and TO Florida at the bottom, set large in the serif, so the drawing says the service in four words.
options.viewport: Text left; the tall road on the right with large From/To place names. On phones a short vertical road with From/To beside it.
options.risk: Repeats New Jersey and Florida from Ed's line just to the left.
